quarterly_data.quarter: LS Cable & System press release: release ls-ec-97-90-ec-bd-94-ec-97-90-eb-84-88-e (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LS Eco Energy (release on LS Cable & System's newsroom about its record Q3 2026 preliminary results): nine-month revenue of KRW 987.3 billion and operating profit of KRW 67.5 billion already exceed full-year 2025 revenue of KRW 960.1 billion and operating profit of KRW 66.8 billion. Growth was led by exports of power cable and busduct to Europe and North America; busduct revenue rose 2-3 times year over year as demand grew sharply with global big tech's hyperscale data-center investment and high-rise construction, centred on Malaysia and Indonesia. CEO Lee Sang-ho: with exports to Europe and North America expanding and AIDC and the new rare-earth business added, he expects revenue and operating profit to keep growing.
quarterly_data.figure: busduct revenue up 2-3x year over year; 9M revenue KRW 987.3 billion vs full-year 2025 KRW 960.1 billion
